@netlify/identity 2.0.0 — MIT — https://github.com/netlify/primitives
Identity's browser transport is distributed from its gotrue-js dependency (MIT).
The application uses @netlify/identity for all authentication operations.
The identity module's transport import points to the locally distributed browser dependency.
